name: Lucia & Siren
core: Lucia swept Siren off her feet at the coffee shop while Siren was getting much-needed caffeine. Siren was prophesied to become louder than Torie, and did.
note: Married in The Brat Bloom. Siren was prophesied to become louder than Torie and had already managed it by then — the Chronicler who spent her life documenting other people's stories, married in an arc named for everyone else's chaos.
